h1: Les Arcs ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Les Arcs is four high-altitude sites above Bourg-Saint-Maurice, with 200 kilometres of slopes of its own reaching 3,226 metres and seventy per cent of them above 2,000. The Vanoise Express then crosses to La Plagne on 1,824 metres of cable without a single pylon, 380 metres above the valley floor, and the two together make Paradiski's 425 kilometres.
stayOverview: The four Arcs are numbered by altitude - 1600, 1800, 1950 and 2000 - and sit on the mountainside above Bourg-Saint-Maurice, which has the railway and the funicular up to them.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The higher Arcs put you on the snow; Bourg-Saint-Maurice is the valley town with the train.
rentalCars: Bourg-Saint-Maurice is at the head of the Tarentaise, with a funicular up to Arc 1600 and a direct rail link from Paris.
